The open-concept layout, high ceilings, and abundant natural light create a bright and inviting atmosphere. The spacious primary suite features a private balcony, while two dining areas offer flexible space for entertaining or a home office. The front yard features a variety of fruit trees, providing seasonal harvests throughout the year.
